defs.def: involving science; connected with science 科学（上）的；关于科学的

ex.s: To illustrate a scientific concept.
ex.t: 阐释一个科学概念。

ex.s: Prior to SLEAP, tracking the physical characteristics of both plants and animals required a lot of labor that slowed the scientific process.
ex.t: 在SLEAP出现之前，追踪动植物物理特征需要大量人工，拖慢了科研进程。

ex.s: Until recently, scientific evidence had been limited to one aspect of morality: kindness.
ex.t: 直到最近，科学证据仅限于道德的一个方面：善良。

ex.s: Due to the lack of scientific proof concerning their impacts, no one has succeeded in winning a lawsuit against cloud-seeding companies.
ex.t: 由于缺乏关于其影响的科学证据，没有人成功起诉过人工降雨公司。

ex.s: Scientific studies have proved Stienwand right.
ex.t: 科学研究证明史蒂文旺是对的.

ex.s: Still, sometimes our assumptions are incorrect, and scientific findings surprise researchers, along with the rest of us.
ex.t: 尽管如此，有时我们的假设是错误的，科学发现会让我们和其余人一样惊讶。

ex.s: Scientific research is inspired by an unknown phenomenon.
ex.t: 科学研究受到未知现象的启发。

ex.s: Direct observation is a must for scientific research.
ex.t: 直接观察是科学研究之必需。

ex.s: Scientific research is guaranteed by sufficient lab facilities.
ex.t: 科学研究由充足的实验室设施保障。

ex.s: Scientific predictions should be mostly based on research models.
ex.t: 科学预测应主要基于研究模型。

ex.s: Unfortunately, this is not a scientific question.
ex.t: 不幸的是，这不是一个科学问题。

ex.s: We can, instead, use this idea to advance scientific knowledge.
ex.t: 相反，我们可以用这个想法推进科学知识。

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

ex.s: They are of high scientific value.
ex.t: 它们具有很高的科学价值。

ex.s: From the English side, we have scientific reports and the captain’s record of that terrible day.
ex.t: 在英国一方，我们有科学报告以及船长对那个可怕日子的记录。

ex.s: His report was scientific.
ex.t: 他的报告是科学的。

ex.s: In the end, I had a new scientific interest to pursue.
ex.t: 最终，我有了一个新的科学兴趣去追求。

ex.s: This track record makes ALife a ripe target for criticism, such as declarations of the field’s doubtful scientific value.
ex.t: 这一记录使"人工生命"（ALife）成为批评的成熟靶子，比如有人宣称该领域的科学价值可疑。

ex.s: To introduce a scientific discovery.
ex.t: 为了介绍一项科学发现。

ex.s: Other scientists may say scientific findings are true because they use “the scientific method.” But we can never actually agree on what that method is.
ex.t: 其他科学家可能说科学发现是真的，因为他们用了“科学方法”。但我们永远无法真正就那方法是什么达成一致。

ex.s: Recently a leading scientist said the scientific method was to avoid fooling oneself into thinking something is true that is not.
ex.t: 最近，一位顶尖科学家说，科学方法就是避免自欺欺人地相信不真实的东西。

ex.s: Each of these views has its value, but if the claim is that any one of these is the scientific method, then they all fail.
ex.t: 这些观点各有价值，但如果声称其中任何一个是科学方法，那么它们全都站不住脚。

ex.s: Scientific Method: Simple Choice
ex.t: 科学方法:简单选择

ex.s: Although the continuing popular appeal of emotional intelligence is desirable, we hope that such attention will excite a greater interest in the scientific and scholarly study of emotion.
ex.t: 尽管情商持续的大众吸引力是可取的，我们希望这种关注能激发对情绪科学和学术研究的更大兴趣。

ex.s: If you decide that you need to read the whole book, decide how much you can read at a time. ____19____ A history book which may contain the facts in story form will be easier to read than one dealing with scientific subjects.
ex.t: 如果你决定你需要阅读全书,就决定你一次能读到多少____19____。 历史书中可能包含故事形式的事实,比一个处理科学课题的书更容易阅读。

ex.s: This idea is a little off-the-wall but still has scientific backing．
ex.t: 这个想法有点离奇，但仍不乏科学依据。

ex.s: The connection between people and plants has long been the subject of scientific research.
ex.t: 人与植物之间的联系长久以来都是科学研究的课题。

ex.s: A scientific study.
ex.t: 一项科学研究。

ex.s: “If we're successful,” their mission statement reads, “we believe this will be one of the most important and widely beneficial scientific advances ever made.”
ex.t: “如果我们成功，”他们的使命宣言写道，“我们相信这将是人类有史以来最重要、惠及最广的科学进步之一。”

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者都必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着计算机、手持设备或驶向遥远行星的交通工具。然而，技术也是应用科学知识解决问题，以无数方式触动生活。

ex.s: It’s partly that his writings rode a wave of social, political and scientific progress.
ex.t: 部分原因在于他的著作乘上了社会、政治和科学进步的浪潮。

ex.s: Inspire scientific research.
ex.t: 启发科学研究.

ex.s: Reports on scientific discoveries.
ex.t: 关于科学发现的报告。

defs.def: careful and logical 做事或思想的方法

ex.s: People have been more inspired by Franklin’s spirit of scientific exploration than by the facts themselves.
ex.t: 富兰克林的科学探索精神比事实本身更能激励人们。

ex.s: Franklin’s spirit of scientific exploration is still considered an inspiration.
ex.t: 富兰克林的科学探索精神仍然被认为是一种灵感.

ex.s: Scientific reasons Risk-taking may be part of 6_______________.
ex.t: 承担风险可能是6               的一部分。

ex.s: So, for accurate and reliable predictions, it’s best to check an official, scientific report.
ex.t: 所以，为准确可靠的预测，最好查官方科学报告。

ex.s: Despite all this, his adventures on this ship would lead to one of the most important scientific discoveries of all time.
ex.t: 尽管如此,他在这艘船上的探险将会导致有史以来最重要的科学发现之一.
